experiment: 6: TransformerLens weight processing as a reparametrisation null: how much of a patching verdict is rounding
status: sealed before job F; single seed
library: transformer-lens 4.4.0 TransformerBridge; processed = enable_compatibility_mode() on a separate copy (fold_ln on RMS, center_unembed; residual not centred), tl.processing() recorded; hooks from mdb.interop.names.to_tl
panel: the 48 base items of results/scale-20261114/panel.json per model, consumer M[answer, donor answer]

predictions.R1: fp32 leg: processed and unprocessed base margins agree within 1e-4 on 48/48 items per model; any larger gap means processing is not a pure reparametrisation on that family
predictions.R2: bf16 leg: |processed - native| on the margin is within mdb's floor on >= 0.9 of items and on >= 0.9 of the patch effects; the 95th percentile of |processed - unprocessed| in spacings is reported against the 2-spacing rule
predictions.R3: among patch effects mdb calls 'effect' (|native| > floor), <= 5% change sign or fall below floor on the processed bridge; among effects below floor, >= 30% change sign
predictions.R4: attention-weight changes >= 0.1 (L_c, last row) occur on 0 items in fp32; bf16-only changes are listed by head
predictions.nulls: unprocessed bf16 bridge vs mdb (parity, expected bitwise for the base forward of the same kernel path); unprocessed bf16 batched vs batch-1 per arm (kernel-path delta)
predictions.falsifier: the 95th percentile of the reparametrisation difference (processed - unprocessed, bf16, same batch layout) exceeds 4 spacings on either model

operational_definitions.patch effects: per item 2H+1: zero each query head's A (hook_z) at L_c and at L_c+1 at the last row, and the carrier V interchange from the donor (the carrier KV group's v at the carrier row, sequence scope). H = 14 (0.5B) or 16 (0.6B), so 29 or 33 per item, not the memo's 20 (stated deviation)
operational_definitions.carrier row: argmax over span rows (t0 excluded, ties to the later row) of the answer row's L_c attention summed over the carrier KV group's query heads
operational_definitions.mdb native: stepped bf16 CUDA: head zeroing by a masked Run.set of A at the last row from a checkpoint at t<last>.L<Lc>.h; V interchange by a masked Run.set of v at t<crow>.L<Lc> with prefill = carrier row (sequence scope)
operational_definitions.TL legs: all arms of an item in one batch (base + 2H + 1) for U16, P16, U32, P32; U16 also batch 1 per arm; fp32 legs on CUDA with TF32 off (deviation: memo says CPU; same arithmetic class, faster)
operational_definitions.floor: 2 bf16 spacings at the largest |logit| of (answer, foil) over the item's arms
operational_definitions.claims: each P16 patch effect (arm - base, same batch) sealed as a supplied-forecast record and judged by analysis.supplied.judge against mdb's native effect (deviation: the memo names interop.verify, whose stepped re-measure costs 5-6 s per claim, issue I4; the native arms here are mdb's own stepped arms)
operational_definitions.R2 statistic: |P16 effect - mdb effect| <= floor per patch; |P16 base - mdb base| <= floor per item
operational_definitions.spacing unit: bf16 spacing at the larger |logit| of the pair
